confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off fetched fundamentals as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from fetched fundamentals/quality, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for in the fetched market file and not found, or not computable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.
